target.name: stock_watson_sv
target.scale_prior: sigma^-2 ~ Gamma(5, rate 0.5); sampled as phi = log sigma^2 with Jacobian
target.parameterization: paper innovations: [phi, z_1, (z_{k+1}-z_k)/sigma, x_1, (x_{k+1}-x_k)/sigma, mu_1, (mu_{k+1}-mu_k) exp(-z_k/2)]; identity mass
target.initial_state_prior: z_1, x_1, mu_1 ~ N(0, s0^2) with s0 below (not stated in the paper; assumption)

data.source: simulated from the model (the paper uses the 1955Q1-2018Q1 US quarterly inflation series, which is not available offline; deviation recorded)
data.fixture_rule: amendment 6 (2026-08-31, before any evidence): initial latent states z1=-6, x1=-2, mu1=2 (low persistent volatility, as in the paper Figure 15 where z drifts from 0 to about -12 and exp(z/2) multiplies the trend innovations); first data seed in the ordered list [2026083120, 2026083121, ...] whose simulated ranges satisfy z in [-14, 0] and x in [-7, 3]. 2026083120 is the first admissible seed: z in [-7.6, -0.5], x in [-6.3, 2.9], y in [-5.6, 5.8]. A numpy leapfrog probe from the true path gives one-macro-interval endpoint errors 4.1e3 / 0.013 / 0.053 / 0.012 at micro steps 0.0125 / 0.00625 / 0.002 / 0.001, i.e. the paper regime where the NUTS step 0.002 is stable and WALNUTS needs about one halving from h/8.

start_rule: amendment 5 (2026-08-31, before any evidence): innovation image of the simulated true latent paths computed at the chain’s own sigma (so all chains start on the true paths); phi = true log sigma^2 + start_log_sigma2_offsets[chain]; then independent N(0, 0.01^2) noise on every coordinate; RNG SmallRng(start_seed + chain).

F.description: fixed paper tuning: delta=0.3, h=0.1, minimum 8 micro-steps per macro-step, WALNUTS-D (walnutpie kernel)

N.description: NUTS-like control: paper's fixed NUTS step h=0.002, no refinement (one level), no local error cap

A.description: paper Appendix C adaptation from conservative delta=1.0, h=0.05; Delta=2, p_a=0.95, Gamma=0.8; identity mass (no mass adaptation)

S.description: non-evidence smoke of amendment 2 (finite penalty policy) at arm-F tuning; 50 discarded / 100 retained

gates.energy_error_headline: fraction of retained orbits with Hamiltonian range (max H - min H) > 2, per arm (paper Figure 16: NUTS has many, WALNUTS none)
gates.paper_claim_reproduced_if: arm F passes all gates and its fraction of orbits with Hamiltonian range > 2 is at most 0.01 while arm N's fraction exceeds 0.10
gates.adaptation_landing: report arm A final delta and h per chain against the paper's 0.3 and 0.1; no gate

superseded_start_rule_v1: phi from the list; all other coordinates independent N(0,1) plus y_1 on mu_1. Produced 100% invalid-evaluation stops at transition 1 in arms F and A and stuck chains in arm N; summarized in artifacts/superseded-start-rule-v1/summary.json; not evidence.
superseded_start_rule_v2: amendment-1 data-informed starts (mu on y, x flat, z flat). With the recoverable policy every F/A transition still stopped at the first evaluation; with the finite-penalty policy (smoke arm S) chains refined to exhaustion at all 8 levels with constant Hamiltonian ranges of about 12 and 482, i.e. the starts were far outside the typical set. Summarized in artifacts/superseded-start-rule-v2/summary.json; not evidence.
nonfinite_policy_note: amendments 2 and 7: the observation exponent exp(-x_t) is bounded at exp(700), gradient components are clipped to +-1e8, and any remaining non-finite evaluation returns log density -1e10 with zero gradient. This emulates the reference walnutpie semantics (failed evaluation = -inf log density, zero gradient, keep halving) on a kernel that otherwise stops a transition at the first non-finite state. Clipping only binds where |grad| > 1e8, i.e. where the macro-step energy error is many orders above delta and no accepted macro step can pass; the sampled target is unchanged on its support of non-negligible density.
draw_reduction_note: amendment 5: 1,000/5,000 reduced to 500/2,000 per chain for every evidence arm after the numpy leapfrog probe showed the fixture needs micro steps near 2e-4 (refinement level 6 of 8, about 512 gradients per macro step) to hold delta = 0.3; projected cost at 1,000/5,000 exceeded the wall cap.
